tier_compliance.reason: "Each cell represents a possible combination of alleles from both parents" connects visible cells to the genetics concept without calculating the probability.

visual_grounding.reason: The reference to four outcomes and "each cell" identifies the four visible Punnett-square cells and explains their role.

unsupported_claims: The claim that the parents have "different body colors" conflicts with the b and b labels for both parents; both are bb.

scientific_correctness.reason: "Two guppies with different body colors" is incorrect for this bb × bb cross: both parents have the recessive golden body color.

steers_toward_wrong_answer.reason: Describing different-colored parents suggests a dominant B allele in one parent, which would lead away from the correct all-bb probability of 4/4.

answer_disclosure.reason: The claim of different-colored parents implicitly rules out an all-recessive cross, excluding the correct 4/4 option without stating an answer.

actionability.reason: Explaining that each cell combines parental alleles provides a clear focus, but the student must work out how to identify and count homozygous-recessive outcomes.
